name: McDonnell Douglas MD-11
summary: A three-engine widebody derived from the DC-10, now flown almost entirely as a freighter, with its US fleet being retired.

wings: Low swept wing with distinctive winglets
engines: Three engines: one under each wing and one in the tail at the base of the fin
fuselage: Freighters have no main-deck windows and a large cargo door forward on the left
tail: Tail engine mounted at the base of a tall swept fin

tellTales: Third engine mounted in the tail at the base of the fin
Wing-mounted engines plus a tail engine on a widebody

confusedWith.howToTell: The A330 has only two engines and no tail engine; the MD-11 has a third engine in the tail.
The 767 has two engines and no engine in the tail; the MD-11 has a tail-mounted third engine.
The 777 has two huge engines and no tail engine; the MD-11 has three engines including one in the tail.
